title: Muster Code — production hardening
releaseRule: No feature is Done until parent live QA and applicable tests have evidence. An N/A requires a reason.

cards.title: Baseline staged app and release contract
cards.acceptance: Confirm exact executable, baseline human flows, capture defects without treating fixture data as live inference.

cards.title: Durable activity and recoverable runs
cards.acceptance: Rich transcript survives reload; disconnected/interrupted states are explicit; no blind write replay.

cards.title: Approval, checkpoint and queue correctness
cards.acceptance: Correct task receives each event/approval; cancelling or removing queued work cannot strand a task or corrupt checkpoints.

cards.title: Exact context metadata and attachment reliability
cards.acceptance: Files, folders, selections and browser refs resolve once; range/truncation/source details are inspectable; failures preserve the draft.

cards.title: Reported per-turn usage ledger
cards.acceptance: Input/cached/output/reasoning usage is reported with correct task/turn ownership; unknown remains unknown; model/effort stay explicit.

cards.title: Chat interactions, long content and rendering
cards.acceptance: Typing, IME, editing, scrolling, expanded state and midstream task switches work at narrow/wide sizes under stress.

checks.stress: partial: Unicode typing and context removal pass; inspector layout failure MC-203

cards.title: Customizable themes and icons
cards.acceptance: Five palettes and customization persist/reset safely; readable controls, keyboard focus and semantic full-file diff colors in every palette.

cards.title: Context, activity and usage inspection UI
cards.acceptance: Exact context and genuine event/usage details remain accessible without blocking typing or scrolling.

checks.stress: fail: expanded inspectors push composer offscreen

cards.title: Browser navigation and diagnostics
cards.acceptance: Success, redirects, refused/offline/invalid URLs, history and overlapping loads settle correctly without stale state.

cards.title: Browser picks, visual edits and context handoff
cards.acceptance: Pick/edit/screenshot/add-to-chat flows retain exact source and complete through a real inference; take-control and cancellation work.

cards.title: Browser stress and lifecycle cleanup
cards.acceptance: Large DOM/console output and repeated open-close/navigation remain responsive with bounded retained resources.

cards.title: Realtime full-file and multi-file diff regression gate
cards.acceptance: Human-prompted streamed edits preserve full-file view, dirty edits, add/delete/move, review/undo and stop-midstream behavior.

cards.title: Agent-owned terminal workspace
cards.scope: new terminal modules; extension command integration
cards.acceptance: Task-labelled terminal sessions show cwd/status/output, reconnect/reopen safely and link commands to changed files without breaking shell semantics. All exposed palette commands must work without hidden arguments.

cards.title: Independent agent workspaces
cards.acceptance: Concurrent editing requires isolated worktrees and task-specific checkpoints; integration cannot overwrite another task’s work.

cards.title: Integrated human-flow and stress acceptance
cards.acceptance: For each feature record happy, negative, edge, normal human, latency, UI regression, regression and stress results; Done only with evidence.

cards.title: Real agent orchestration and event graph
cards.scope: Codex protocol adapter; runtime agent graph; owning-tab messages
cards.acceptance: Real spawned/managed agents have explicit provenance, parent/child identity, live status, messages, per-agent changes and supported controls; no fabricated progress.

cards.title: Agent workspace and sub-agent screen
cards.scope: Agent hierarchy/list/detail view; message and change timelines
cards.acceptance: User can inspect active children, their assigned work, main↔child messages, changes and actual state, and perform supported actions without disrupting chat or diffs.

cards.title: Codex-grade thread and project management
cards.scope: Thread catalog/actions; extension commands; UI contract
cards.acceptance: Search/filter/page real threads, pin/rename/archive/restore/fork/open with correct identity, scope and recoverable capability errors.

cards.title: Evidence-backed IDE/harness parity matrix
cards.scope: Official Codex and two open-source references
cards.acceptance: Map user workflows to implemented/missing/experimental support with primary sources and concrete acceptance criteria; do not equate UI mockups with real functionality.

cards.title: End-to-end agent and thread workflow gate
cards.scope: Live staged IDE and provider-backed QA tasks
cards.acceptance: Type a real delegation task, observe child creation/work/messages/changes, inspect/steer/stop a child where supported, then reopen/recover/search/manage threads with no identity mixup or lost work.

cards.title: Mac navigation and discoverable shortcuts
cards.acceptance: Files, commands, symbols, lines, tasks, terminals and review reachable by keyboard; cancel restores focus; existing diff and inline-edit shortcuts retained.

cards.title: Customizable glass appearance
cards.acceptance: Five palettes retained; Graphite default; glass/solid choice persists; high contrast and reduced transparency fallback; composer and long content stay visible. Host glass setting and reduced-transparency/high-contrast fallbacks still need integration.

cards.title: Reuse host computer-use capability
cards.scope: installed host bridge; app-server capability boundary
cards.acceptance: Document installed transport and permissions; integration only through verified interface; explicit availability, ownership and stop state; no secret copying.

cards.title: Subscription live voice in Muster
cards.scope: Experimental app-server thread/realtime methods; successful catalog probe; audio session not tested
cards.acceptance: Verify account-backed transport without extra API key; implement only with proven capability; mic, speaker, cancellation, reconnect, transcription and tool-state QA.

cards.title: Native worktree workspace hub
cards.scope: Git worktree registry; list/create/open in separate Muster windows; no Orca requirement
cards.acceptance: Open or create isolated worktree from Muster; retain correct repository/path ownership; show service and route state without exposing credentials; dirty work protected; no duplicate dispatch.

integration.live: pending integrated stage; baseline inference passed

productTarget: Full-featured Codex-first IDE: thread/project management and real agent orchestration are primary, with preserved editing/browser/terminal workflows.
appearance: Neutral Graphite default; multiple palettes remain selectable; semantic diff colors preserved.
